metadata.title: JavaScript: filter articles by title and category
metadata.description: Filter an article array by a normalized title query and an optional category without mutating the input.
metadata.instructions:
# Filter articles

Implement `filterArticles(articles, query, category)`.

- Search article titles case-insensitively.
- Trim whitespace around the query.
- The category "Все" includes all categories.
- Otherwise match the selected category exactly.
- Do not mutate the array or its objects.

Check an empty query, no matches, and combined query/category filtering.

Editorial note: the original script starts with an unrelated React task comment. This instruction override describes the JavaScript functions actually present in script.js.

metadata.title: React: article favorites
metadata.description: Build an article favorites list with toggle buttons, a derived counter, and an accessible clear action.
metadata.instructions:
# Article favorites

Build an `ArticleFavorites` component using the supplied articles.

- Show article titles and favorite-toggle buttons.
- Store selected article IDs with `useState`.
- Derive the favorites count from the selected IDs.
- Toggle selection without mutating state or adding duplicate IDs.
- Use `aria-pressed` to expose button state.
- Add a clear button, disabled when there are no favorites.
- Removing one article must preserve the other selections.

Editorial note: these instructions describe the existing nested ArticleFavorites.jsx example; README.md is a Vite template.
